title: luzula campestris subsp. vulgaris
intro: Luzula campestris subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as field woodrush, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Juncaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of field woodrush include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of field woodrush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
